newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TML Reed buys two Cape-based shows.
newsitem.headline: TML Reed buys two Cape-based shows.

text.p: South Africa's TML Reed Exhibitions said on Thursday it had acquired two Cape Town-based trade shows from Exhibition Management Services (EMS).
The two shows are the Cape Business & Industrial Trade Show, which is in its fourteenth year and the Cape Media & Marketing Exhibition, which has run for four years.
"Both Western Cape shows are well established, and we plan to build on their success," managing director Jo Melville said in a statement.
The purchase of the two Cape shows brought to 21 the number of exhibitions organised nationally by TML Reed.
TML Reed is a division of media group Times Media Ltd.
